decision: Three weathered steel fuel drums for provisional static game decoration. The supplied 296,253-triangle TRELLIS GLB and saved image show three closely overlapping drums in one mesh. Spatial separation crosses 1,307 source faces and topology has 1,888 disconnected components, so clean complete cylinders were rebuilt instead of cutting incomplete source shells. The source image guides blue-gray enamel, rolled rims, recessed lids, bungs, rust and grime. Three slightly different individual drums and a three-drum arrangement are exported with embedded PNG color and roughness maps. Approximately 3.52-stud height, decoration role and non-collision are provisional. User visual approval, Studio import and map integration are pending.
